title: Sheehan gets access to every internal Scientology file
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Sheehan gets access to every internal Scientology file, about 1970s at Church of Scientology headquarters, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I said that look I wouldn't even meet with Ron hubard unless there was a condition precedent that I could be given access to every single document anywhere in the world uh in internal files of the Church of Scientology

plain: A man named Dan Sheehan, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s he dealt with the Church of Scientology, a religious movement founded by L. Ron Hubbard, at its headquarters in Florida. Sheehan says he refused even to meet Hubbard unless he was first given access to every internal document the church held anywhere in the world, including the files of its Guardian's Office, the church's internal security and legal branch. He tells it to show how deep his inside view of the organisation went.
